_comment: Coverage universe of the Hyperscaler Hub (owner's choice, 2026-10-08): the five majors, Microsoft, Alphabet, Amazon, Meta and Oracle, with full filings-based data. fyEnd is the fiscal-year-end month (1-12). counterparties: the listed neoclouds and developers the owner removed from coverage on 2026-10-08 (comparability: together they spend about 6% of the majors' capex, fund it with converts and equity and depend on one or two customers). They have no financials, tables or quality counts on the hub; their SEC filings are polled (submissions API, no XBRL) and harvested only so that Circular can cite the capacity contracts and investments the majors hold with them, the way OpenAI and Anthropic appear through the majors' own filings. Filer category and forms come from the EDGAR submissions API on every run, never from this file.

counterparties.name: Nebius
counterparties.note_en: Foreign private issuer: annual report on Form 20-F (XBRL); quarterly results are furnished on Form 6-K without XBRL, so quarterly figures are not in the automated feed.
counterparties.note_es: Emisor privado extranjero: informe anual en Forma 20-F (XBRL); los resultados trimestrales se entregan en Forma 6-K sin XBRL, por lo que las cifras trimestrales no entran al flujo automático.
